run_gen_status_files: run the script to generate status name text files for each PrivateComputationInstanceStatus enum value
run_main: run the main entry point that generates read-only status resource files in the test_resources directory
create_gen_status_files: create read-only text files for each PrivateComputationInstanceStatus value in a given output directory
review_gen_status_files: review the gen_status_files function that iterates over status enums and writes immutable status name files
refactor_gen_status_files: refactor gen_status_files to support a custom file suffix or additional metadata in generated status files
